listitem.para: Path of file to be loaded.
Flag specifying the color type of the loaded image, can be:

itemizedlist.member: CV_LOAD_IMAGE_ANYDEPTH: return a 16-bit/32-bit image when the input has the corresponding depth, otherwise convert it to 8-bit.
CV_LOAD_IMAGE_COLOR: convert to a color image.
CV_LOAD_IMAGE_GRAYSCALE: convert to a grayscale image.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: imread loads an image from the specified file path and returns the Mat object containing it.
